notes:
What's New in Shale 1.0.138
Draft generated from commit messages since Shale 1.0.137. Review and edit before publishing.

New
• Add targeted Phase 1R read RLS candidate and isolated synthetic acceptance
• Implement default-off integration persistence and security foundation
• Add isolated default-off OAuth authorization server foundation
• Implement durable self-consent and PKCE authorization code transactions
• Implement opaque OAuth credential issuance and rotating refresh candidate
• Implement Phase 3B.3 audited Case disclosure seam

Improvements
• docs: reconcile auth retirement and shared API/MCP roadmap
• Replace elevated installer scripts with native per-user registration
• Document legacy migration and verify standard-user installer contracts
• Preserve native build JDK resolution and scheduler safeguards
• test(cases): prove shared secured minimized read operations
• Formalize stable v2 Case REST and OpenAPI contract
• docs: define Phase 3A MCP security and delegation contract
• docs(ai): record Phase 3B.2A OAuth compatibility blocker
• build(server): migrate to supported Spring Boot 4.1.1 baseline
• Validate authorization-code exchange with pinned client proof and durable replay
• Record Phase 3B.2C.1 verification and bounded credential roadmap
• Harden explicit issuance transaction and record verification blockers
• Verify durable OAuth lifecycle and prevent disabled-family resurrection
• Complete authenticated RFC 7009 credential revocation closeout
• feat(ai): validate opaque ACCESS authority through confined live SQL gates
• test(ai): record bounded ACCESS verification and unresolved expiry race
• docs: close Phase 3B.2D expiry-race verification gap
• docs: record blocked Phase 3B.4 MCP compatibility gate
